field.label: Balancer Tag
field.help: Name this balancer (letters, digits, _ . -). Routing rules select it from the «Balancers» group in Target Outbound, and the template then writes balancerTag instead of outboundTag. Use a unique tag: do not reuse direct, block, api or a node tag.

field.label: Node Selector (tag prefixes)
field.help: Type a tag prefix and press Enter. Prefixes match outbound tags from the start, so «node_» selects every configured node; «node_ab» narrows it. The stable node_<uuid> tags mean no reconfiguration is needed when nodes are added or removed.

field.label: Strategy
field.help: random — pick a random node; roundRobin — rotate through the nodes in order; leastPing — lowest measured latency; leastLoad — lowest load. leastPing and leastLoad require an enabled observatory in General Settings → Load Balancer Observatory — without one Xray refuses to start and Apply is rejected with an error.

field.label: Fallback Tag
field.help: Outbound used when the selector matches no usable node or every probe fails. Leave empty (recommended) to fail closed: traffic then has no route instead of silently leaving through direct without the proxy. Set direct only if you accept that exposure; block drops the traffic explicitly. Xray applies a fallback only when an observatory is enabled in General Settings → Load Balancer Observatory; otherwise this field is ignored.
